title: Minimum site area of proposed lots (Table 3B)
text: Minimum and average site area. C4.1.1 Development which complies with the dwelling type and site area provisions set out in Table 3B and the following provisions. Table 3B Site area requirements. Site area per dwelling (m2), Min: R2 5000; R2.5 4000; R5 2000; R10 875; R12.5 700; R15 580; R17.5 500; R20 350; R25 300; R30 260; R35 220; R40 180; R50 160; R60 120; R80 100; R100-SL 80. R80 site area provisions apply to all grouped dwellings located on lots coded R100, R160 and LR, MR and HR. - Indicated not applicable. C4.1.5 In areas coded R25 and below; for a small dwelling (in accordance with C2.9.1) that is the subject of a proposed development, the minimum and average site area of Table 3B may be reduced by up to 35 per cent. C4.1.6 In areas coded R30 to R40; for an accessible dwelling designed to gold level universal design (in accordance with C2.7.1), or a small dwelling (in accordance with C2.9.1) that is the subject of a development proposal, the minimum and average site area of Table 3B may be reduced by up to 35 per cent, provided that: i. for grouped dwellings, no site is less than 100m2; and ii. for development or subdivision of 4 or more dwellings or sites, the site area reduction is limited to a maximum 50 per cent of the total number of dwellings or sites. C4.1.7 In areas coded R50 and above; for an accessible dwelling designed to gold level universal design (in accordance with C2.7.1), or a small dwelling (in accordance with C2.9.1) that is the subject of a development proposal, the minimum and average site area of Table 3B may be reduced by up to 35 per cent, provided that: i. for grouped dwellings, no site is less than 100m2; and ii. the site area reduction is limited for small dwellings to a maximum 50 per cent of the total number of dwellings or sites.

exceptions.label: C4.1.5 small dwelling at R25 and below: minimum and average site area reduced by up to 35%
C4.1.6 gold-level accessible or small dwelling at R30 to R40: reduced by up to 35%, no site under 100 m2, at most 50% of 4 or more sites
C4.1.7 gold-level accessible or small dwelling at R50 and above: reduced by up to 35%, no site under 100 m2, small dwellings at most 50% of sites

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

verified.note: Minimum values checked. C4.1.7(ii) 'the site area reduction is limited for small dwellings to a maximum 50 per cent of the total number of dwellings or sites' (p53) does not say how it applies to a single dwelling or lot or to gold-level accessible dwellings; the C4.1.7 exception keeps verify true.

notes: diverges: Table 3B (p54) for Table 2B; test otherwise as the Chapter 2 twin. Applies where the application creates lots; the smallest proposed lot. C4.1.5 to C4.1.7 concessions as exceptions (area / 0.65 against Table 3B); 50% caps use subdivision.lot_count and subdivision.reduced_lots_count (dwellings or sites).
